description: This is a main route/component file for the front-end of a personal notes manager application built with Qwik framework. It defines the main page layout, including search functionality, navigation for creating new notes, and displaying a list of notes or an empty state.

methods.name: component$
methods.description: Main functional component initializing the notes context, handling search input, deletion, and rendering note list or empty state.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Function to handle deletion of notes by ID, invoking the remove action from notes context.
